signature_moves: Polymorphic detail pane — one structural slot swaps between rendered newsletter, full analytics dashboard, Clean View popover, and developer-grade Message Diagnostics
Data-viz as the sole boldness budget: disciplined system-default chrome everywhere, expressive hue-coded composition bar + stat tiles as the one loud surface (80/20)
'Clean View' tracker/ad/clutter stripper surfaced as a glass popover with per-newsletter / per-sender / all-time removed-count telemetry
Highlights named in system identity hues (Yellow/Mint/Sky/Rose/Lavender) via a native pull-down — custom feature spoken in platform colour vocabulary
Unread carried by font weight + a blue dot, not colour — hierarchy by de-emphasis
defects: Tracked-uppercase table headers — Message Diagnostics columns ('APPEARANCE / COLOR / STATUS / DETECTED AT') set in letter-spaced caps; HIG lists-and-tables wants sentence-case secondary headers. Sporadic (one surface) web/enterprise tell, the app's only non-native seam

aesthetic.direction: Neo-grotesque product rendered as platform-native — no committed custom aesthetic; inherits SF Pro, system materials, single system accent, and lets one data surface carry the personality

psychology: Von Restorff — single accent + one expressive data surface; the diagnostics bar and stat numbers are the remembered 'different thing' against quiet chrome
Hierarchy via de-emphasis (Refactoring UI) — unread bold vs read regular; secondary-grey sender/label vs near-black title/number; value outranks label on tiles
Jakob's Law — three-pane Mail/reader shell means zero learning cost; users arrive pre-trained on the layout

Aesthetic-Usability + processing fluency — strict system-consistent tokens (radii, accent, selection grammar) read as trustworthy; the one tracked-uppercase-header inconsistency is the kind of near-miss that subtly costs fluency
Zeigarnik / self-monitoring — stat dashboard (counts, streák-like Today/Week/Month tallies, First Newsletter date) turns a mailbox into a progress surface
notes: Cover and shot-1..6 are marketing composites (device-free app window on a colour-gradient backdrop with a heavy grotesque headline); only the app window inside is design evidence, and it is high-res @2x (2880x1800, ~1440x900 logical) so measurements are reliable. The detail pane frequently renders THIRD-PARTY newsletter HTML (Techmeme, Grow Omaha, WSJ) whose centred bold headings and serif/Arial body are the newsletters' own web typography — do NOT attribute that type to Letterboxx's system. All surfaces are light mode; no dark-mode evidence. No settings window, onboarding, empty state, or sheet/alert seen. App icon (stacked-airmail-envelopes render) present but not digested (Workflow A / UI only) — flag for a later icon pass. Sole member of a proposed 'native-faithful reader' cluster; nothing here is promotable to canon alone.
